before: A tag label had one opaque tone, published as data-cc-tag-tone; a field had one, as data-field-tone, asked at paint; a control's content was always laid out as its own text and words.
after: A tag label, a control and a field carry the host's names, published as data-piece-*. A control the host makes an atom lays out its plain text as one piece and is met as one unit; a field with a face is an atom too. An atom or a chip may carry a measured mark slot the host's painter fills, and an atom carries its own hover and selection.
reason: Layout and paint of the host's view only; nothing reaches the document, an operation or shared updates.
